title: The Stars with Rhonda: The Enemy Is in the Building
description: Rhonda reads the stars. Every sign has a nemesis, and the nemesis is already inside. Ronnie tries to find the exit.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And now, the stars. <p:0.3> With Rhonda.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Good evening. The heavens are at war tonight, and so, dear listener, are you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Okay, war is a strong open. Let's, uh, let's get to a sign.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Aries. You have an enemy. <p:0.3> They are in the building.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: In the... which building? My building?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Taurus. The coworker who took the last good chair has begun a campaign against you. It will end one of you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: End one of them? Over a chair? Surely you mean, like, professionally.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: I mean as I have said it. Gemini. Your nemesis has read the group chat. They are screenshotting.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Oh, the screenshots. That one's real, folks, that one actually happens.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Cancer. You brought a casserole to the potluck. So did your rival. <p:0.3> Only one dish comes home empty.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: See, a casserole standoff, that I can root for. Bring the noodles. <p:0.3> Wait, who's the enemy in MY building, you never said.

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: Leo. Your foe sits closer than you think. They host a small show. They ask too many questions.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's... <p:0.3> that's just a description of me. Rhonda. Rhonda, am I the enemy in the building?

lines.speaker: rhonda
lines.text: The stars don't name names, Ronnie. <p:0.3> They just unlock the studio door.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: It locks from the INSIDE! <p:0.3> We'll be right back. If I'm back.
